note: Keya Paha County zones unincorporated land under 1996 Resolution 96-3-2 (AG-1, AG-2 districts) with an Official Zoning Map; village limits (Springview, Burton) are mapped separately. No ArcGIS REST or other queryable service of zoning districts was found in ArcGIS Hub/Online or web searches. The county website returned HTTP 503 (Wordfence rate limit) on every page tried, so the county's zoning map could not be inspected directly. Regrid parcels carry zoning for only ~13% of parcels and are not a district layer.
